tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs kyi sgrub pa tshe sgrub g.yung drung gur khang
item.coloph: tshe sgrub g.yung drung skye mo tshal/ gur khang sra brten brag ri gtams/ 'di 'dra bon gyi snying khu 'di/ chu pho stag lo rta zla tshes/ gnas mchog brag dkar rtse rdzong la/ yum chen thugs rje kun sgrol gyis/ kho bo pad+ma g.yung drung bdag la/ snyan du brgyud nas/ phyi rabs don du yi ger btab/ snyan rgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur khyab pa dang*/ 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa la 'khod par shog ces dben gnas me ri khrod du gtan la phab pa yin//
